rationale: Final source-grounded entry for the read-path family, because the run's budget expires at the end of this turn and this is a code-established mechanism rather than a measurement: the periodic heartbeat carries only the most recently admitted pending request context, while each admission triggers its own broadcast and acknowledgments are tracked per context. That distinction is exactly what a reviewer needs when weighing the earlier coalescing and starvation findings, so it is recorded with its sources and no execution or interpretation is claimed.

knowledge.statement: The leader's periodic heartbeat path attaches the read-only context of only the most recently admitted pending request: bcastHeartbeat takes readOnly.lastPendingRequestCtx(), which returns the rctx of the last entry in readIndexQueue and an empty value when the queue is empty, and passes it to bcastHeartbeatWithCtx (raft.go:722-730 with read_only.go:114-121). Each admission instead triggers its own broadcast carrying that request's rctx through sendMsgReadIndexResponse, and acknowledgments are tracked per context bytes by readOnly.recvAck, with readOnly.advance dequeuing the statuses up to the acknowledged context (raft.go:2142-2157, read_only.go:68-112). So a periodic heartbeat refreshes only the latest pending request, every pending request has already had its own admission-time broadcast, and no context is attached when nothing is pending.
knowledge.conditions: The node is StateLeader with ReadOnlySafe; read requests are admitted through MsgReadIndex so that statuses exist in readOnly, and the heartbeat timer fires while the queue is either empty or non-empty.
